reason: I count the drawer myself every night with 5 to 10 staff, so seeing cancelled bills, walk-outs and what cash should be there, from my phone, is exactly the leak I worry about. With the first month free I'll try it, and a branded app makes the salon look modern.
objection: ₹999 a month is one more fixed cost that doesn't stop in slow months, plus ₹4,999 upfront, and if my stylists don't bother with the selfie check-in and billing every time, the numbers are useless.
